segments.label: Launch & ascent — Kennedy Space Center LC-39A
segments.note: SpaceX Falcon Heavy from Kennedy Space Center LC-39A (28.608°, -80.604°); ~9 min analytic ascent to a 185 km parking orbit (schematic arc, real pad and launch time).

segments.label: Parking orbit coast
segments.note: Circular 185 km parking orbit, inclination 34.1° (plane through the pad at launch and the Moon at arrival — the launch-window geometry). Coast 116 min to the trans-lunar injection burn.

segments.label: Trans-lunar coast (5.1 days)
segments.note: Two-body Lambert arc from the TLI point to the modeled LOI point (Moon's position from the ephemeris at LOI). Departure Δv 3135 m/s, arrival v∞ 0.84 km/s. Mid-course corrections not modeled.

segments.label: Lunar orbit (~104 km, 23.8 rev)
segments.note: Circular orbit after LOI (published 100 km; modeled 104 km so that the orbit reaches the descent-orbit-insertion point exactly at DOI). Plane contains the arrival asymptote and the landing site; inclination 90.4°.

segments.label: Descent orbit (104 × 15 km)
segments.note: Descent-orbit insertion lowers perilune to 15 km opposite the powered-descent point; 0.5 revolutions to PDI (DOI modeled at 2026-11-22T08:48:40Z).

segments.label: Powered descent & landing
segments.note: Powered descent integrated for the lander class (Generic CLPS-class lander (parametric): 4.0 kN, Isp 315 s, 1650 kg at PDI): 14.5 min, Δv 1979 m/s. Model, not telemetry. Published duration ≈12 min.

notes: Projected route: the provider's previous flight profile applied to the announced window; dates are illustrative until the launch is scheduled.

Griffin Mission One is NET November 2026 (Falcon Heavy, KSC LC-39A). No launch date is scheduled: the route is drawn for an illustrative mid-window date with a direct ~5-day transfer and ~2 days in lunar orbit before landing near Nobile.
TLI placed at 2026-11-15T07:04:42Z (published/nominal 2026-11-15T05:45:00Z): the point on the parking orbit was chosen for a tangential departure toward the Moon.
